title: Bunny in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="28" rx="8" ry="22" fill="#f0c8a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="28" rx="8" ry="22" fill="#f0c8a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="28" rx="4" ry="16" fill="#e8a0b0"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="28" rx="4" ry="16" fill="#e8a0b0"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="22" fill="#f0c8a0"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="58" r="5" fill="#e8a0b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="58" r="5" fill="#e8a0b0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="50" r="4" fill="#4a80d0"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="50" r="4" fill="#4a80d0"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#e8a0b0"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 63 Q50 67 54 63" stroke="#c08070" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1="25" y1="54" x2="34" y2="56" stroke="#d4a070" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="58" x2="34" y2="59" stroke="#d4a070" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="56" x2="75" y2="54" stroke="#d4a070" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="59" x2="75" y2="58" stroke="#d4a070" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Scarf body -->
  <path d="M28 72 Q50 82 72 72 L70 78 Q50 88 30 78 Z" fill="#e04040"/>
  <path d="M28 72 Q50 82 72 72 L70 78 Q50 88 30 78 Z" fill="#e04040"/>

  <!-- Scarf band -->
  <path d="M28 70 Q50 78 72 70 L72 74 Q50 82 28 74 Z" fill="#d03030"/>

  <!-- Scarf knot -->
  <rect x="44" y="72" width="12" height="8" rx="3" fill="#e04040"/>
  <rect x="45" y="73" width="10" height="6" rx="2" fill="#f06060"/>

  <!-- Scarf tail -->
  <path d="M55 78 L60 92 L52 90 L50 80 Z" fill="#e04040"/>
  <path d="M56 80 L59 90 L54 89 L53 81 Z" fill="#f06060"/>

  <!-- Body hint -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="16" ry="8" fill="#f0c8a0"/>
</svg>
